title: Tune fair play
body: Fair.Configure on the fair-play process, inside its bounds. Request-Price must follow the beacon's request price (whole RNG): give both proposals the same Effective-At. A Request-Price change is money; the window, sizes and limits are harmless. The beacon and token are fixed. It moves money or code, so it carries Effective-At (filled by dao-propose: the vote's end + 24 h + 1 day of margin); it takes effect only then, when anyone sends Gov.Apply, and until then validators may leave by the exit hatch (Exit-Now) and the DAO may cancel it (Gov.Cancel).
